categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and changes CRollingBloomFilter implementation in src/common/bloom.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents CRollingBloomFilter from rotating generations prematurely when duplicate items are inserted. As described, 'Re-inserting a value already represented by the current generation advances its entry counter without adding membership information,' causing earlier expiration of unrelated entries than configured.
